mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 72 degrees at Verona Community Park. The moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase. If you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 5:05 AM, rising over the Verona High School area and passing high in the sky toward the Oregon and Fitchburg direction for seven minutes.

The City of Verona has officially unveiled a new public art piece called Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This seven-foot sculpture, carved from a reclaimed ash tree, was donated by Gerri Gurman and features animal figures inspired by Tai Chi. City staff are also planning to add multi-lingual signage and native landscaping around the site in the coming months.

It is a busy day in Verona today. You can visit the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, attend a yoga session at Insight Wellness, enjoy a pizza and pitcher special at Lake Lou-ee, or participate in trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, you can also join the fun at Hop Haus trivia night.

Regarding the weekly police report, on August 25, officers were dispatched to a medical emergency where they utilized an AED to revive a patient who was pulseless, successfully restoring his pulse before EMS arrival.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
